name: get_game_creation_bundle_file
description: Read a safe text file or directory from the game-generation resource folder. Use this after get_game_creation_instructions when the instructions require any resource file.

path.description: Whitelisted bundle file or directory path, for example 'references/build-game.md' or 'scaffold/web/package.json'.

include_contents.description: For directory paths, include the content of every allowed file under that directory. Defaults to false.
